content.text:
Finding submitted.

**WARRANTY — deviation.** IBM's §5.1 warranty covers only performance of the Services with reasonable care and skill by qualified personnel, plus a narrow compliance-with-laws covenant. There is no conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no warranty period, and no stated remedy; §5.4(c) affirmatively supplies all Materials "AS IS", §5.4(a)–(b) disclaims error-free operation, defect correction, capacity and performance, and §5.2 makes §5.1 exclusive. That fails the fallback on two material terms and touches the walk-away position.

Redline (validated, preferred level): insert a new §5.1(c) giving a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty for Deliverables and Materials with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund as the remedy, and prefix §5.4(c) with "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1" so the disclaimer no longer swallows the express warranty.
